feature: Endpoint approve officer kedua POST /v1/furnish/officer/approve (cek PS, update hirer/driver, revive TS-PDP, auto TS-HST, email/SMS custom, lalu status Approved)
note: Controller dan service menyebut 'OCMS 41 User Stories 41.15-41.23' tetapi ocmsadminui tidak memanggilnya (grep furnish/officer di ocmsadminui/src: 0 hasil) dan path itu tidak ada di api-authorization.properties; UI memakai manual-review/approve-hirer|driver. Email dikirim sebelum status diubah ke Approved dan tidak ada penjadwalan. Tidak dipakai sebagai bukti story.
note_en: The controller and service cite 'OCMS 41 User Stories 41.15-41.23' but ocmsadminui never calls them (grep furnish/officer in ocmsadminui/src: 0 hits) and the path is not in api-authorization.properties; the UI uses manual-review/approve-hirer|driver. The email is sent before the status becomes Approved and nothing is scheduled. Not used as story evidence.
